title: Equal-share primary coverage over 24 weeks
method: Synthetic staffing worksheet: 24 primary weeks divided by equally available qualified responders. Excludes secondary duty, leave and recovery time; not a universal sustainable staffing threshold.
alt: Equal-share primary coverage over 24 weeks. Illustrative values: 8 responders 3 primary weeks, 6 responders 4 primary weeks, 4 responders 6 primary weeks.
